Name: (AT or CP) Orcinus orca Tractor or Horse
Author: Tunkaa
Description:
[font=Tahoma][quote]
最喜欢的mod之一就是Tractor Mod，每天高频使用，所以一直想着自己画一个皮肤

人生中的第一个mod由此诞生（鼓掌.jpg）

One of my favorite mods is the Tractor Mod, which I use frequently every day, so I've always wanted to create my own skin for it.

The first mod in my life was thus born (applause.jpg)[/quote][/font]
